name: JSHookMCP
tagline: Search-First Agentic Cross-Domain Reverse Engineering Workspace for AI Agents
description: JSHookMCP is an open-source MCP server (npm: @jshookmcp/jshook, AGPL-3.0) providing 735 tools across 36 capability domains. It unites runtime telemetry across the full 7-layer stack: Network (HTTP/2, gRPC, WS) <-> DOM Events <-> JS AST & Turbofan JIT <-> WASM <-> Native Memory & Frida <-> Headless Unicorn Android JNI emulation (nemu) <-> OS Syscalls. It features a Search-First 3K-token profile ladder with hybrid BM25 + ONNX micro-embeddings to prevent LLM context bloat.
highlights: Search-First 3K-token profile ladder (BM25 + ONNX + RRF + RL FeedbackTracker)
Cross-Domain Causal Evidence Graph (network down to native JNI and kernel syscalls)
Headless Native Android JNI emulation without devices or emulators (nemu / Unicorn)
Flutter and Dart AOT snapshot runtime introspection (dart-inspector)
Chromium Mojo IPC sniffing and mocking (mojo-ipc)
Cheat Engine & ReClass grade in-memory forensics (AOB scanning, pointer maps, vtables)
